trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours — there is no separate task. Play the story, work the roadmap stages in order, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because the game has no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but your progress counts from the start and nothing on it is missable. It tracks the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the stunts — use this guide's roadmap stages as its checklist. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; GTABase for the checklist layout.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay, and the ending is yours to choose. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count (300 count toward 100%). Stunts are the ramps, jumps and air tricks scattered across the map — work them in the same sessions as exploration, and watch the counter in Stats. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; Push Square for the 397 total.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 Shooting Range challenges, each needing a gold medal. Learn one range's rhythm at a time and use Combat Focus to steady your aim — the medals are the longest grind of this stage. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement and the 42 count.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands, each a short chain with its own final mission. They unlock across the map as the story opens up Leonida — meet every stranger marker you pass and finish each chain, including the five side characters with their own final-mission trophies. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three full card sets, found as collectible cards across Leonida. Cards are tucked into shops, hideouts and mission areas — sweep one region at a time and tick each set off in the tracker. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. Any spot where the app prompts counts — pair it with exploration so the counter climbs while you map the state. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked close beats a fast car found afterwards. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each: races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, stunts and the rest the game lists under Activities. One session visiting each is enough. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; GTABase for the nine types.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: A Top Fun drone race win at every drone race location. Learn each course's corners — the drones are quick but the courses are short, so a clean line beats raw speed. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races won — each race counts once, so spread across the map instead of repeating one favourite. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when it appears and keep the line steady — it is one duel, not a grind. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to the end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through in one sitting. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, per guide sites. This is the one trophy that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; PowerPyx and Output Lag for the missable warning and the 18 spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges completed — the game's challenge list spans activities, combat and exploration, so they pile up naturally while you chase the other trophies. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. A quiet stretch of highway and a fast car make the escape the easy part. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row with your partner, wanted level intact throughout. Pick three close shops, keep it quick, and do not stop for anything between them. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: One hundred different vehicles discovered — every car, bike, boat and aircraft you climb into counts. Explore garages, docks and airfields as you travel. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five enemies in one Combat Focus. Find a group, trigger focus, and work through them before the meter runs out. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A jewelry store robbery with no detection. Go in quiet, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — speed matters less than silence. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take its cargo and escape. Ambush it on a quiet road where your getaway car is already waiting. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Every region of Leonida visited. Drive the whole map — the coast, the swamps, the Keys and the city — and the trophy follows the journey. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation robbed from each gang. Each gang's operation is its own job — work through them gang by gang. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank the clean money as you go and the total climbs on its own. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars and properties all count. Big purchases late in the game will carry most of it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Save this for when the robbery money is flowing — garages are the priciest habit in the game. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you find and register count — snap them as you discover them. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game — just play. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before it ends, meditate at Lucia's balcony — that spot disappears after the chapter and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; Output Lag for the meditation warning.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start — the game has no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Keep a manual save from before it — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — his final mission closes his story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — his final mission closes his story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — his final mission closes his story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — his final mission closes his story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — his final mission closes his story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His strand sends you after one particular animal — take the hunt when it comes. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Exactly how is still being worked out by players; try the runways and the terminals and watch for the prompt. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Something to do with the Rhino tank — the description is a joke, and players are still pinning down the exact trigger. Try the tank in free roam and around the military areas. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on the beachfront, order a drink, and take in the view. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass, GTA style. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a game there and see it through. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description is a joke and the trigger is still being worked out. Likely tied to a partner activity done well. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — a story choice trophy. It unlocks when a story decision is made; keep a manual save before the big choices. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a retry trophy. Fail something once, then land it on the second try. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — an easter egg trophy. Players are still hunting the exact trigger; check the sources page as the community pins it down. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement; the method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock pins over from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the requirement.
